SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM (
  SELECT pr.ref1
  FROM prod_rvw AS pr
  JOIN prod AS p ON p.prdc_id = pr.ref1
  WHERE p.sll_end_dt IS NULL
    AND p.dscn_dt IS NULL
  GROUP BY pr.ref1
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
) AS t

SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM (
    SELECT p.prdc_id
    FROM prod p
    JOIN prod_rvw r ON r.ref1 = p.prdc_id
    WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1
    GROUP BY p.prdc_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
) t
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM (SELECT p.prdc_id FROM prod AS p JOIN prod_rvw AS r ON r.ref1 = p.prdc_id WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1 GROUP BY p.prdc_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) AS prod_with_reviews
